Keywords: slow query where filter full scan seq scan
Strategy: B-tree index on the filtered column(s); composite index ordered by equality-first then range
Code Good: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status_created ON orders (status, created_at)
Anti-Pattern: Indexing low-cardinality boolean alone; composite ordered range-first
Verification: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) shows Index Scan; rows estimate ≈ actual

Keywords: order by limit sort top n latest
Root Cause: Sort node over the whole table for a top-N query
Strategy: Index matching the ORDER BY direction (including DESC/NULLS) so LIMIT walks the index
Code Good: CREATE INDEX idx_events_created_desc ON events (created_at DESC)
Anti-Pattern: OFFSET pagination for infinite feeds (use keyset)
Verification: Plan shows Index Scan Backward / no Sort node

Keywords: n+1 loop per row lazy load orm repeated query
Root Cause: Hundreds of identical queries differing only by id
Strategy: Eager-load relations / batch with IN(...) or JOIN; dataloader pattern at the API layer
Code Good: SELECT * FROM comments WHERE post_id IN (...)
Anti-Pattern: Fixing with a cache instead of the access pattern
Verification: Query count per request flat vs item count

Strategy: Trigram index (pg_trgm GIN) or full-text search (tsvector + GIN); dedicated engine beyond ~10M rows
Code Good: CREATE INDEX idx_users_name_trgm ON users USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops)
Anti-Pattern: Forcing LOWER() without an expression index
Verification: Plan shows Bitmap Index Scan on the GIN index

Keywords: join many tables slow hash join nested loop
Root Cause: Mis-estimated join order / missing join keys index
Strategy: Index every FK used in joins; verify row estimates; break monster joins into CTE/temp stages when estimates collapse
Anti-Pattern: Disabling nested loops globally; hint-chasing before stats are fresh
Verification: Estimates within ~10x of actuals at every join node

Keywords: group by count sum report aggregate slow
Strategy: Pre-aggregate: materialized view / rollup table refreshed on schedule or trigger; partial indexes for hot subsets
Code Good: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW daily_rev AS ... REFRESH CONCURRENTLY
Anti-Pattern: Caching in app memory only (cold-start storms)
Verification: Dashboard reads hit the rollup, not base tables

Strategy: Keyset/cursor pagination on a unique ordered key
Code Good: WHERE (created_at,id) < (:c,:i) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
Anti-Pattern: Hiding offset behind a 'page' param and capping at 1000 as a fix
Verification: p99 latency flat across page depth

Keywords: deadlock lock wait contention update hot row
Strategy: Row-level design: ledger inserts over UPDATE-in-place; batch with SKIP LOCKED queues; keep transactions short
Code Good: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for workers
Anti-Pattern: Retrying deadlocks blindly without ordering writes
Verification: Lock wait time ~0 under load test; deadlock rate 0

Keywords: wrong plan estimate stale statistics analyze
Root Cause: Optimizer estimates wildly off → bad plans
Strategy: Auto-analyze tuned for big tables; manual ANALYZE after bulk loads; extended statistics for correlated columns
Code Good: CREATE STATISTICS s_dist (dependencies) ON city,country FROM addr
Anti-Pattern: Hinting every query instead of fixing stats

Keywords: insert slow many indexes write amplification
Root Cause: Each extra index taxes every INSERT/UPDATE
Strategy: Audit with index-usage stats; drop unused; covering index to replace several near-duplicates
Anti-Pattern: Adding an index per slow query without retiring old ones
Verification: Write p95 recovers; no unused-index rows

Keywords: select star wide row toast network payload
Strategy: Project needed columns; covering index enables index-only scans
Anti-Pattern: Compressing payloads instead of trimming the select list
Verification: Plan shows Index Only Scan where applicable
